description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 06.12.2021 to 12.12.2021
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance, establishing new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges. It is a regulatory instrument that modifies how the law is applied (specifically Section 17 of the Customs Ordinance), making it a clear example of a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5). While a government official (the Director General of Customs) is named, this is in the context of exercising a statutory power to issue a regulation, not a personnel appointment or change in government structure. The core content is purely regulatory.
